title: Deleting Fake Profile Impersonating You
titleMr: बनावट (Fake) अकाऊंट डिलीट व ब्लॉक करण्याची प्रक्रिया

steps.title: Report Inside the App Immediately
steps.desc: Open the fake profile -> Click the 3 dots (...) at top right -> Select 'Report' -> Choose 'It's impersonating someone I know' or 'Impersonating me'.

steps.title: Get 5 Friends to Report the Same Profile
steps.desc: Meta's AI automated moderation removes fake profiles faster when multiple independent accounts flag the same profile for impersonation within 24 hours.

steps.title: Submit Official Meta Takedown Form (No Account Needed)
steps.titleMr: अधिकृत मेटा (Meta) फॉर्म द्वारे टेकडाऊन मागणी करा
steps.desc: If the profile is not deleted within 24 hours, use Meta's web form: facebook.com/help/contact/295306987286129 to submit identity proof for immediate removal.

steps.title: Lock Your Original Facebook Profile
steps.titleMr: तुमचे मूळ प्रोफाईल लॉक (Lock Profile) करा
steps.desc: Go to your Facebook profile -> Click 3 dots -> Select 'Lock Profile' to prevent scammers from downloading your photos for future fake profiles.

title: Recover Hacked WhatsApp Account
titleMr: हॅक झालेले व्हॉट्सॲप अकाऊंट परत मिळवणे

steps.title: Re-install WhatsApp & Enter Your Number
steps.titleMr: व्हॉट्सॲप पुन्हा डाऊनलोड करून तुमचा नंबर टाका
steps.desc: Re-register on WhatsApp by entering your phone number and requesting SMS verification code.

steps.title: Enter 6-Digit SMS Code to Log Out Hacker
steps.desc: Once you enter the 6-digit SMS code, the hacker will be AUTOMATICALLY logged out from their phone.

steps.title: If Hacker Set Two-Step Verification PIN
steps.titleMr: हॅकरने पिन लावल्यास ७ दिवस थांबा किंवा सपोर्टला मेल करा
steps.desc: If prompted for a 6-digit PIN you don't know, the hacker activated 2FA. You must wait 7 days to reset the PIN without code. Meanwhile, email support@whatsapp.com with subject: 'Stolen/Lost: Please deactivate my account' and your phone number in full international format (+91XXXXXXXXXX).

steps.title: Broadcast Warning to Contacts via SMS / Call
steps.desc: Inform family that your WhatsApp was compromised so they do not transfer money to the hacker.

title: Removing Morphed / Intimate Photos Online
titleMr: एडिट / मॉर्फ केलेले फोटो इंटरनेटवरून हटवणे

steps.title: Do NOT Delete Original Photos from Phone
steps.titleMr: तुमच्या फोनमधील मूळ फोटो डिलीट करू नका
steps.desc: Original photos contain camera metadata needed by Nashik Cyber Police for forensic investigation.

steps.title: Generate Digital Fingerprint on StopNCII.org
steps.titleMr: StopNCII.org वर डिजिटल हॅश (Hash) तयार करा
steps.desc: Visit StopNCII.org (Non-Consensual Intimate Imagery portal). The site generates a unique digital hash fingerprint of the image ON YOUR PHONE without uploading your actual photo, and automatically blocks Meta (Insta/FB), TikTok, and major tech platforms from sharing it.

steps.title: File Urgent Complaint with Nashik Cyber Police
steps.titleMr: नाशिक सायबर पोलिसांकडे तातडीने नोंद करा
steps.desc: Visit Nashik Cyber Police Station (Gangapur Road) or call 1930 / Samanvaya Portal to get direct police intervention for takedown notices under Section 67A IT Act.

title: Cyberbullying & Account Takedown
titleMr: ऑनलाईन छळ आणि अकाऊंट ब्लॉक करणे

steps.title: Take Full Screenshots Before Blocking
steps.desc: Capture profile handle, exact post URLs, timestamps, and abusive chat messages.

steps.title: Use Platform Restriction & Block Features
steps.desc: On Instagram, choose 'Restrict' so the bully cannot see when you are online or leave visible comments.

steps.title: File Takedown Notice on Nashik Samanvaya Portal
steps.desc: Register complaint on Nashik Cyber Cell's Samanvaya Portal for police-directed platform notice.
